name: @authstunt/playwright
description: Playwright fixtures for AuthStunt: one run per worker, one identity per test, released even when the test fails.

scripts.smoke: node -e "const m = require('./dist/index.cjs'); if (typeof m.test !== 'function' || typeof m.expect !== 'function' || typeof m.authstuntFixtures !== 'object') { throw new Error('cjs smoke failed') }" && node -e "import('./dist/index.js').then((m) => { if (typeof m.test !== 'function' || typeof m.expect !== 'function' || typeof m.authstuntFixtures !== 'object') { throw new Error('esm smoke failed') } })"
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run smoke && npm run check:package && npm run test
